answer: A farm of 324 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in oasis, queued in pulse, and tundra publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 21 identities per epoch. A farm of 4639 identities would post 3318 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
